name: Free System
description: Ribbed tatami-like pads with interchangeable curved and inclined backs. The strongest fresh match to Additional System.
bedNote: Can form a flat lounging platform. No dedicated mattress or verified overnight performance.
priceNote: Reissue / vintage research needed · likely a stretch
availability: Model reference · stock unverified

name: Amanta
description: Deep tufted cushions sit inside conspicuous moulded shells. Modular space-age seating with a current reissue route.
bedNote: Sofa only. Separate sculpted shells do not create a continuous mattress.
priceNote: Vintage and HAY reissue prices to compare
availability: Photo example sold · current collection exists

name: DS-600 Non-Stop
description: Narrow leather modules join into an articulated snake. Repetition and visible construction taken to an extreme.
bedNote: Sofa only. Shaped seats and repeated joints; no guest-bed function.
priceNote: Stretch reference · a full landscape is not a €5k assumption
availability: Model reference · stock unverified

name: Alanda
description: Articulated padded headrests and arms on a slim steel structure. A mechanical, adjustable branch of the same taste.
bedNote: Adjustable lounge surface. No dedicated mattress; overnight suitability and dimensions unverified.
priceNote: Vintage hunt · price and delivery to research
availability: Sold photo reference · model to hunt

name: Duc
description: Leather-covered structural panels joined with exposed zips. The interest is in the construction and the thick loose cushions.
bedNote: Sofa only; no sleeping conversion.
priceNote: Vintage price and delivery to research
availability: Historical auction reference · not live stock

name: Sapporo
description: Enormous cushions within a thick rounded walnut frame. A wood-and-leather branch to test against the metal-and-foam favourites.
bedNote: Sofa only; no conversion.
priceNote: Vintage price and delivery to research
availability: Model reference · stock unverified

name: Oblò
description: Playful red frame and yellow upholstery; converts to a single or double bed.
bedNote: Mohd specifies an included 136 × 202 cm polyurethane mattress, 10 cm thick. Sofa width 275 cm; open depth 165 cm.
availability: Model reference; exact stock and Berlin delivery unverified

name: Clam
description: A sculptural upholstered shell that unfolds into a double sleeping surface.
bedNote: Manufacturer specifies an articulated mechanism and 136 × 190 cm sleeping surface; confirm the current German version.
availability: Model reference; exact stock and Berlin delivery unverified

name: Nomade Express
description: Buttoned mattress-like upholstery and cast-metal legs; a direct follow-up to your three-heart Multy.
bedNote: Official specification: 140 × 200 cm Bultex sleeping mattress, 16 cm thick. Linked used example is pickup only in Seligenstadt; arrange transport separately.
availability: Model reference; exact stock and Berlin delivery unverified

name: Boa
description: New, oversized rounded upholstery around an actual folding bed.
bedNote: Official specification: 16 cm mattress; 140 × 200 or 160 × 200 cm sleeping surface. Order the sofa-bed version, not the fixed sofa.
availability: Model reference; exact stock and Berlin delivery unverified

name: Brooklyn
description: Retro upholstery on slim metal feet with a real pull-out mattress.
bedNote: Manufacturer confirms a pull-out mattress on welded-steel sleeping support. Confirm the size in the quoted configuration.
availability: Model reference; exact stock and Berlin delivery unverified

name: BR 02
description: Colourful upholstery on a tubular steel frame; the seat pulls forward into a single guest bed.
bedNote: Single sleeper only. Manufacturer dimensions: 192 × 100 cm overall when opened; verify usable sleeping width on the exact vintage piece.
availability: Model reference; exact stock and Berlin delivery unverified

name: Concentré de Vie
description: Orange tray, green blocks and blue cushions rearrange into a tiny living landscape. The most radical extension of your three-heart Oblò and Superonda.
bedNote: Manufacturer confirms the central support becomes a single bed. No usable mattress dimensions or week-long comfort verified; discontinued, so this is a resale hunt.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Dynamic Life
description: Colour-blocked foam folds into two lounging positions or one wide bed. More playful and architectural than a conventional pull-out.
bedNote: Official sleeping surface 130 × 202 cm. Foam platform rather than a separate sprung mattress. Out of collection.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Papillon XL
description: Two butterfly wings on a chrome skeleton; dramatic in orange, red or olive. The opposite of an anonymous sofa bed.
bedNote: Reclining wings form a 120 × 200 cm usable sleeping surface in the 2018 catalogue. The standard Papillon is only a single: look specifically for XL. Dealer outer opened dimensions differ from mattress dimensions.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Revolve
description: A chunky capsule whose whole back rotates 180°. Strong object-like shape, particularly in saturated green or rust.
bedNote: Official opened dimensions 210 × 140 × 38 cm; cold-foam sleeping surface. Conversion is verified; test firmness before a week-long stay.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Up-Lift / sofa version
description: Giant circular arms act like wheels as the sofa rolls open. A properly strange little machine, not decorative styling.
bedNote: Choose the 1.5- or 2-seat sofa, not the armchair. Two-seat version opens to 160 × 200 cm overall; dealer specifies usable mattress 150 × 195 cm. Listed entry price may be the narrower 1.5-seater.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Big-Bag
description: A fat mattress landscape with portable, leather-handled backrests. A practical route toward the loose, puffy construction you liked in Strips.
bedNote: Dealer specifies a 14 cm mattress; single 112 × 200 cm or unfolded double 193 × 185 cm. The double is unusually short in one direction: check your guests’ height.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

description: A red vintage transformer: the back and arms fold outward into bedside tables. Wheels, visible fittings and a genuine covered mattress.
bedNote: Single sleeper, not a double. A documented example has a 77 × 192 cm mattress; dimensions vary between examples. Inspect foam and folding fittings.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Slalom
description: An offset chaise arrangement slides around like dominoes into a bed. The transformation is part of its sculptural appeal.
bedNote: Manufacturer catalogue specifies 120 × 210 or 140 × 210 cm sleeping configurations. Discontinued; confirm the exact size and complete mechanism on a used example.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Pil-Low
description: An oversized wedge cushion, conspicuous seams and a folded geometric silhouette. A sharper cousin of your quilted foam favourites.
bedNote: Official diagrams show a 200 × 155 cm opened platform. Seat lifts and rotates, back folds flat; storage below.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Twin / paired seats
description: Two orange steel frames become high-backed seats, twin beds or a joined bed with bedside tables. This is a deliberately odd alternative to a conventional couch.
bedNote: Two narrow 60 × 200 cm beds, or one joined 120 × 200 cm bed. These are paired seats, not a normal low sofa. Manufacturer archives it as out of collection, although retailers still list it.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: ABC
description: An asymmetric all-foam corner with a huge backrest and no exposed bed chassis. Close to Superonda’s rearrangeable softness.
bedNote: Converts to two 82 × 200 cm single beds or one 165 × 200 cm double. Choose left- or right-hand version; manufacturer confirms the conversion.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Doc / bunk-bed sofa
description: The surprise is mechanical: an ordinary-looking sofa rises into two stacked beds. Included for the extraordinary transformation rather than its daytime outline.
bedNote: Two separate single beds with slatted bases, integrated ladder and safety barrier. Confirm mattress dimensions and installation clearances. Use the ladder in the support position specified by Clei.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Di-Tra-Verso
description: A low, rounded, nearly continuous upholstered volume. The sideways opening keeps it from becoming a long mechanical runway in your apartment.
bedNote: Official mattress 155 × 200 cm, 12 cm thick. Opens across the sofa’s long side; overall width 246 cm and opened depth 175 cm.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Pierrot King
description: A quilted floating cushion on thin chrome legs. Less cartoonish, but an unusually good-value way into the Strips / Multy side of your taste.
bedNote: Bonaldo catalogue gives 120 × 200 cm usable sleeping surface; verify this on the exact King version. Backrest folds flat, with an intermediate lounge position.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Day-Night
description: An exposed steel frame and revolving backrest turn a sofa into a proper single mattress. Vintage construction with almost prototype-like directness.
bedNote: Single-bed mattress with revolving back; outer sofa size on the linked dealer example 214 × 84 cm. Inspect mattress condition and measure the usable sleeping length.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Tango
description: Big, rounded, deliberately overstuffed cushions. A more usable week-long guest-bed direction if you like the inflated look.
bedNote: 16 cm mattress, in 140 × 195 or 160 × 195 cm sizes. Synchronized backrest opening; confirm the exact mattress and fabric in the quote.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Piazzagrande
description: Quilted padding with clipped edges and a low armless outline. A practical, contemporary relative of Strips rather than a conventional armchair-shaped sleeper.
bedNote: Manufacturer confirms 140 × 195 or 160 × 195 cm sleeping sizes. Linked larger-bed configuration is 160 × 195; check the mattress thickness with the seller.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Ospite
description: A skeletal wooden bench-bed with coloured textiles and a blue crossbar. The light, witty Magistretti alternative to a bulky pull-out.
bedNote: Emergency single sleeping pad 77 × 190 cm in the original catalogue; current reissue dimensions should be confirmed. A thin folding pad: do not assume it equals Multy for a week.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Gobbalunga
description: An armchair with an absurdly long, jointed upholstered tail. It curls into a conversation space or stretches into a reclining landscape.
bedNote: Lounging and lying down are confirmed; no proper overnight mattress or week-long sleeping performance verified. This is the sculptural wildcard, not a substitute for a tested sofa bed.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Commedia
description: Blue metal, a round wooden rail, sculpted arms and a huge blanket become a collage of separate parts. Playful without looking like a novelty prop.
bedNote: Includes an 80 × 200 cm mattress, blanket and four cushions. A fixed single daybed; no double-bed opening.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: DS-80
description: Patchwork leather and a visible slatted frame. The closest extra de Sede reference to your favourite DS-85, with a much leaner silhouette.
bedNote: Fixed single daybed, not a fold-out double. Vintage examples are approximately 190–200 × 90 cm overall; check the usable surface and foam condition.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Constanze
description: Buttoned leather on a fine chrome frame; a single motion drops the back into a broad horizontal surface. Stronger on mechanics than colour.
bedNote: Vintage examples open to roughly 195–200 × 107–110 cm overall. Daybed surface, no separate pull-out mattress; not a comfortable full double.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Taipi
description: Padded sail-like backs swing outward into curved arms. A wonderfully odd cross between an Empire sleigh bed and a modernist sofa.
bedNote: Manufacturer calls it a daybed. Retailer specifies an 80 × 200 cm, 25 cm-thick foam mattress. Single sleeper; not a double.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Ikoi
description: A pink-and-green bench with a triangular middle that spins into a chaise. A compact graphic object rather than a lounge blob.
bedNote: Designer lists a 195 cm-long, 60 cm-wide bench and occasional single bed. Very narrow for overnight use; not a double and not a first choice for a week.
availability: Model reference; stock, condition and Berlin delivery need confirmation

name: Morfeo
description: A friendly alien with two luminous antennae. The lights bend around you, and a real mattress folds out from inside. Stronger character than almost any normal sleeper.
bedNote: Manufacturer catalogue specifies a 130 × 180 cm mattress: noticeably short. Outer sofa 200 × 90 cm, opened depth 225 cm. Inspect the bed mechanism, foam, fabric and both lamps on a used example.

name: Slash
description: A huge segmented caterpillar mattress folded over an exposed metal skeleton. Flash-green versions are especially good. The transformation is the whole visual idea.
bedNote: Manufacturer verifies a sofa that unfolds into a large double bed. Archived model; exact usable dimensions and foam condition must be checked on the actual example.

name: Tandem
description: A colourful picnic kit pretending to be a sofa: its padded blocks dismantle into a table, seating and two mattresses. More domestic playground than conventional couch.
bedNote: Manufacturer describes two separate mattresses, rather than a normal pull-out double. Confirm their usable dimensions and that all pieces are included. Discontinued.

name: Chama / double
description: An enormous folded futon with two round pillows, almost like a soft cartoon animal. Ask for contrasting coloured piping and a saturated fabric.
bedNote: Choose the double sofa, not the narrower Chama armchair. Dealer outer dimensions are 178 cm wide and 100/208 cm deep; these are not the usable mattress dimensions. A floor-level futon, without a raised pull-out bed.

name: Circle sleeper / quilted
description: A green-and-brown patchwork semicircle that opens into a full round bed. Very close to the spirit of Superonda, with an unmistakably seventies silhouette.
bedNote: The linked example is SOLD. Dealer documents the circular conversion and two infill footstools; closed width 195 cm. Bed diameter and whether both infills are present need checking on any replacement find. Attribution to a named designer is not verified.

name: Kiss Kiss
description: A stripped-back padded slab with a crease running through it. Big colour, very little furniture language; it flips from sofa to bed in one movement.
bedNote: Manufacturer explicitly verifies the sofa-to-bed conversion. Exact bed size is not supplied on the current archive page: confirm it on the specific piece. Discontinued.

name: Ori.Tami
description: A little origami throne that unfolds into a surprisingly large floor bed. Orange, acid green or saturated blue suit its angular, almost paper-cut shape.
bedNote: Chair rather than a multi-seat sofa when closed. Dealer documents a 140 × 190 cm floor mattress. Brera has a €1,583 catalogue reference, but its product page asks for a quote and supply confirmation.

name: Huggy / patchwork
description: A giant scoop of patchwork upholstery squeezed into a bucket. Pull the bucket away and the mattress unrolls; invert the bucket and it becomes the bedside table.
bedNote: Armchair bed, not a sofa. Mattress 175 × 85 × 17 cm: too short for many adult guests and not a first choice for week-long stays. Linked white/patchwork showroom piece is listed available; confirm condition and delivery.

name: Xito
description: A flat, flexible creature that bends into seats, loungers and a little landscape. The most radical option here if you like low living and saturated colour.
bedNote: Floor lounger / mattress landscape, not a conventional pull-out bed. Catalogue footprint about 212 × 137 cm and 13 cm padding; usable flat area depends on position. Test the metal joints and comfort before planning week-long stays.

name: Gea
description: A huge upholstered cone with a secret interior: part shell, part reading cave, part private nap room. About as far from a normal couch as you can get.
bedNote: Wildcard: a fixed resting pod, not a convertible double sofa. Manufacturer calls its interior a bed, but the 180 × 175 cm outer footprint does not establish an adult-size flat sleeping area. Confirm usable dimensions; treat as a nap pod until verified.

name: Deep Attention and Sleep
description: A little orange-accented spaceship for reading and working. Its padded enclosure comes apart and opens onto the floor as a mattress. A wildcard for a room with a very strong personality.
bedNote: Seat/work bay rather than a normal sofa. Manufacturer verifies the removable padded section becomes a floor mattress. Usable mattress dimensions and supply are unverified; discontinued.

name: Nessy
description: A bright green, long-necked sofa creature. This is the deliberately ridiculous sculpture wildcard: it makes a room feel like a playground.
bedNote: SOFA ONLY. Manufacturer describes a sculptural flexible sofa, with no verified flat sleeping surface or mattress conversion. Keep this one separate from practical guest-bed contenders.

name: Ulisse
description: A half-moon sofa that swings open into a full circular bed. The chrome rail and animal-print upholstery make this a particularly good match for the bolder end of your shortlist.
bedNote: The manufacturer verifies two rotating semicircular plywood platforms and an unfolding mattress. This showroom example specifies a 215 cm diameter bed, 30 cm high; closed 215 × 110 × 70 cm. Round bedding and the circular footprint need planning. Ask the dealer for current condition photos and a Berlin delivery quote.

name: Quadrangolo
description: Three irregular quilted islands pivot on concealed wheels, like an upholstered tangram. They can form a linear sofa, an angular arrangement or a double bed. More sculptural and less conventional than a pull-out sleeper.
bedNote: The Biesse product description explicitly includes a double-bed configuration. Published 210 × 175 × 75 cm dimensions describe the overall composition, not a verified usable mattress size. Confirm the flat sleeping area, joints and foam on the actual piece. No live priced example verified.

name: Easy Sleep
description: A huge mattress folded into a soft zigzag, held by oversized side buttons. A simple sculptural idea with the low, puffy character you liked in DS-85, Strips and Big-Bag.
bedNote: The manufacturer catalogue verifies a double sofa bed: 170 cm wide, 115 cm closed / 210 cm open depth, with a 190 cm sleeping length. A separate used listing specified 170 × 190 cm. That €1,100 listing is now removed: this is a resale search reference, not an available offer.

name: Tattomi / TA-155
description: An angular padded sheet that folds like a giant tatami mat. The wide, two-person version is the one to hunt, especially in moss or acid green; the small chair version is excluded from this entry.
bedNote: TA/155 is 155 cm wide, 95 cm deep closed and 215 cm long fully flattened, about 20 cm high. Choose TA/155 explicitly: TA/95 is a chair bed. De Padova recommends two people for transforming the wide version. Check joints and foam; gallery photos illustrate the design family and colours, so confirm the photographed width before buying.

name: DS-77 / vintage sleeper
description: The chunkier, modular cousin of your DS-76 favourite. Each seating section opens forward into a canvas-covered mattress, creating a big low leather-and-fabric sleeping landscape.
bedNote: Only the 1970s folding sleeper qualifies; the later Stephan Hürlemann DS-77 is a different design. The German dealer calls this DS-76/DS-77: attribution must be checked from the actual label. Listed as a set of two sofas, not €3,899 per sofa; each sofa is 191 cm wide and opens to 225 cm overall depth. Dealer gives 137 × 183 cm extended seating dimensions, not a standard mattress measurement. Condition is good with leather creasing, not confirmed mint.

name: Blitz
description: A giant cylindrical bolster hovering over a quilted platform and chrome tubing. In the multicolour upholstery it feels like playful Italian pop furniture rather than a guest-room sofa.
bedNote: Manufacturer verifies the transformation: remove the roll and lower the seat. Mohd specifies an opened bed of 165 × 195 cm, 30 cm high, with a wooden-slat support inside the padded mattress. Closed sofa 165 × 97 cm. The bolster can stand upright on the floor.

name: Le Vele Video
description: Two swivel seats on a sliding metal platform. The pieces separate, spin and stretch into a double bed; a small table appears between them. One of the most mechanically eccentric vintage options.
bedNote: Two seats unfold into two singles or a double, approximately 160 × 200/204 cm depending on version. Confirm the exact model and mattress condition. The €600 Bologna example has a small upholstery tear; mechanisms reported working.

name: Piumotto / sleeper
description: Squashy orange leather, giant rounded cushions and a very low stance. The seating pulls out to become a real single bed. Softer and more playful than the usual mid-century sleeper.
bedNote: Two-seater sofa, 160 × 96 × 75 cm, extends into a single bed with 99 × 194 cm slatted base. Good vintage condition with normal wear. Seller attributes design to Arrigoni; no surviving label.

name: DS-78
description: Crumpled black leather, big folds and rounded side cushions. A compact cousin of the de Sede sleepers you like, with modules that unfold forward.
bedNote: Dealer explicitly confirms the two-seater unfolds to a sleeping surface. Closed 170 × 86 × 74 cm; open mattress dimensions not published, request measurement before buying. Professionally cleaned, minimal wear.

name: Monster / sleeper
description: Rose-patterned red velvet, exaggerated arms and animal-claw feet: gloriously excessive. The sleeper version hides a pull-out slatted bed under all that theatrical upholstery.
bedNote: The linked €600 example explicitly has a pull-out sleeping function with slats and is described as very good. Listing location is Cologne but text says collection in Bonn Bad Godesberg; clarify location and mattress dimensions. A separate €199 Kleinmachnow listing includes Berlin delivery and specifies 160 × 200 cm, but has fading and a stain. Do not confuse it with the €150 Charlottenburg example, which has a broken slat and torn fabric.

name: Samba
description: A gloriously inflated brown sofa with one continuous sculpted seat and exaggerated folded side cushions. A much wilder vintage detour from the usual European classics. Current example is at a Brazilian design gallery.
bedNote: Dealer states that a side lever transforms the upholstered sofa into a bed. Closed dimensions150 × 100 × 80cm; unfolded sleeping size is not provided. Gallery photographs include several configurations.

name: Gao
description: Bulging quilted upholstery and an oversized carrying handle make this a proper French postmodern oddball. A real 1976 sofa-bed classic, confirmed by Cinna itself. The current cream example is already in Berlin-Charlottenburg, but the seller reports substantial wear.
bedNote: The sofa unfolds into a double bed. Manufacturer archive verifies the 1976 sofa-bed design; the current seller explicitly describes conversion to a large double sleeping surface. Exact opened mattress dimensions and condition need checking. Current offer is fair condition, not pristine.

name: Moule / medium
description: Two seats rotate independently through90° like giant green wings, then unfold into a bed. Sculptural, mechanical and genuinely useful; the green used example is already in Hamburg and professionally cleaned/prepared.
bedNote: Brühl explicitly specifies a140 × 204cm bed for the two-seat MouleMedium. Rotate both seats90°, lower the armrests and fully recline the backrests. Removable/replaceable covers. This entry is the two-seat sofa, not a chair or fixed three-seat variant.

name: Popeye / sleeper
description: A compact, exuberant Bretz sleeper with exaggerated upholstered curves and the brand’s eccentric furniture language. A more unusual alternative to its familiar recamieres, with a stated full-length double sleeping position.
bedNote: Seller describes a 140 × 200 cm sleeping position and a sofa footprint of 184 × 120 × 82 cm, seat height47 cm. Listed good condition, cushions included, collection only in Versmold. Ask for a demonstration of the mechanism and inspect foam, slats and covers. Named designer and manufacture year are unverified.

name: Kenthia
description: A low blue velvet block framed by bright steel details. Pulling the seat out turns its architectural 1970s silhouette into a wider sleeping platform. A rarer Saporiti design.
bedNote: Dealer gives sofa 200 × 84 × 70 cm and bed 200 × 110 cm footprint; confirm actual usable mattress width, since 110 cm is the total open depth. Excellent vintage condition.

name: Et Voilà
description: An enormous soft geometric block with almost no visible structure. Unzip the front and flip the backrest behind the seat: the monolith becomes a floor-level bed.
bedNote: Manufacturer confirms actual sofa-to-bed conversion by unzipping and flipping back. Retailer gives overall size 195 × 110/145 × 95 cm; exact usable mattress surface should be confirmed. Removable covers.

name: Tira&Molla
description: A sculpted mattress perched on a visible scissor mechanism. Extending its metal skeleton turns the small sofa into a double bed; the exposed engineering is half the appeal.
bedNote: Use the sofa version, not the narrower chair. The current used example is 163 × 85 × 88 cm with 153 × 190 × 12 cm mattress on wood slats. Covers faded in places despite little use.

name: Relaxy
description: A wonderfully mechanical early Italian sleeper. Its spring deck adjusts into forty positions, and the whole seat slides out to form a bed. Bernini’s example keeps the vintage industrial character.
bedNote: Pull out the seat using the handle, remove the back and place it beneath the seat to create a one-and-a-half-person bed. Closed approximately 193 × 77 cm; exact usable sleeping dimensions need confirmation. Wear consistent with age.

name: AA1
description: A rare Aalto design in chrome instead of bent plywood: the entire padded plane rotates flat inside a thin tubular frame. A numbered modernist design classic and an unusually graphic sleeper.
bedNote: MisuraEmme verifies that the back and seat adjust all the way to 180° to form a bed. Current Italian seller dates the piece to the 1990s and describes very good condition, but the original cover needs washing and the elastic straps have lost some tension. Seller gives 203 × 90 × 63 cm overall; usable sleeping surface needs measuring. Gallery shows manufacturer design-reference photos, not condition photos of the offered piece.

name: IPE folding sleeper
description: A thin upholstered ribbon balanced on black metal legs. One movement levels the back into the seat, turning an angular Italian sofa into a single bed; striking in a strong coloured textile.
bedNote: The current Dutch dealer explicitly documents the sofa-to-bed movement, with a reupholstered grey-melange example. Closed 192 × 70 × 64 cm. A separate restored example gives 188 × 88 cm in bed mode; those measurements are a model reference, not guaranteed for this offer. Ask for the actual usable mattress dimensions. Exact Reno model attribution is unverified, so this entry is not labelled Reno.

name: Sleep-O-Matic
description: An early Italian design classic with a fine metal skeleton, brass legs and a seat that slides forward on tracks. Less cartoonish, but the mechanism and the low floating silhouette are special.
bedNote: Seller explicitly documents a seat mounted on a track that pulls out to create a single bed. Closed dimensions 190 × 84 × 75 cm; usable opened width must be measured. Listed reupholstered and very good. The description and material table disagree about leather versus velvet: confirm the cover material on this actual example.

name: Convertible / 1961
description: Caillette’s sharp, floating upholstered box sits on black metal runners. A rarer French design classic, professionally restored with new foam and fabric rather than a tired original.
bedNote: Seller specifies that it opens to a 130 × 190 cm bed. Closed sofa is 215 × 86 cm with 43 cm seat height / 83 cm back height. Sleeping length190cm is short for taller guests.

name: Prestige
description: A scarce French classic with crisp sculpted cushions, tall asymmetric-looking back and elegant black tubular legs. Restorer lists new Bultex foam and Créations Métaphores wool upholstery.
bedNote: Designed as a three-seat sofa that converts into a double bed. The restorer lists it as a sofa/lit; a separate dealer archive explicitly describes the double-bed conversion. Closed dimensions210 × 95 × 85cm; opened mattress size not published. Gallery shows a separate sold green example as a design reference, not the €2,900 restorer item.

name: Pull-out sleeper / Lotus family
description: A Dutch design classic with a very light black frame and warm timber arm pads. The restored example is in stock at a specialist workshop; less wild, but excellent as the clean architectural counterpoint.
bedNote: The Lotus75 seat slides forward to make a single bed. Conversion is explicitly documented by Ztijl. Current restored sofa is 193 × 73 × 68 cm; exact usable bed width should be confirmed with SixtyFruits. Single sleeper, not a double. Current seller identifies Rob Parry but does not specify the Lotus75 model number: exact variant attribution needs checking.

name: 540 / Siësta
brand: Van der Sluis Stalen Meubelen / Casala
description: Original Dutch steel-and-wool sleeper with an almost impossible-looking floating seat. An alternative to the Martin Visser sofa, with a distinct square steel frame. Current example has original Ploeg wool upholstery.
bedNote: Pull the seat forward to convert from sofa to a single bed. Casala still documents model540/00 as Siësta sofa-bed designed by Gijs van der Sluis. Current vintage seller says conversion works smoothly. Sleeping length about190cm; confirm mattress width.

name: 1982 four-seater sleeper
description: A broad, low Italian sleeper with unusually generous horizontal proportions. A more restrained vintage fallback in this group, but with a properly sized pull-out double bed.
bedNote: Unfolded bed is 142 × 200 cm, 54 cm high. Closed sofa 215 × 94 × 74 cm. Listing states excellent vintage condition and manufacturer attribution mark.
